title: FLUID/SuRRF: supraglacial lake detection and depth retrieval from ICESat-2 ATL03, with Sentinel-2 fusion and random-forest depth modelling

creators.name: Arndt, Philipp S.
creators.affiliation: Scripps Institution of Oceanography, University of California San Diego; Global Fishing Watch

creators.name: Fricker, Helen A.
creators.affiliation: Scripps Institution of Oceanography, University of California San Diego

description:
Related publication. Arndt PS and Fricker HA, “Five Years of ICESat-2 Supraglacial Lake Depths Improve Greenland Meltwater Volume Estimates”, submitted to Annals of Glaciology, 2026. This record will be updated with the full citation and DOI once the paper is available.

Source code for the FLUID/SuRRF framework, which detects supraglacial lakes in ICESat-2 ATL03 photon data and retrieves along-track water depths, together with the code that fuses those depths with Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance to build a machine-learning training set, and that trains and evaluates the random-forest depth models.

Contents: icelakes/ (FLUID detection, NSIDC access, utilities), lakeanalysis/ (SuRRF depth retrieval and plotting), GlacierLakeIS2ML/ (Sentinel-2 fusion, feature engineering, random-forest development), HTCondor_submit/ (OSG Open Science Pool campaign configuration), and zenodo_build/scripts/ (the build and verification scripts that produced the accompanying data records).

This is the version used for the accompanying paper. It is research code written for one campaign, not a packaged library.
